zh: 萬佛峰。山門緊閉，二十年來，沒有人見過峰上的佛者。
洛先生，佛者真的會見我們嗎？
他不見我們。可他不會不見，一個快要死的人。
無涯！二十年了。老朋友來看你，帶了一個，你一定會救的人！
洛無塵。你這一聲，把老衲二十年的禪，都喊破了。
你的禪，若是一聲就破，那也不必再坐了。
幽冥死氣，已入心脈。再晚三個時辰，大羅金仙也救不回來。
阿彌陀佛。老衲出關，本來就是為了救人。
佛光入體，死氣一寸一寸，從凌雲霄的心脈裡被逼了出來。
不必謝老衲。要謝，就謝這個姑娘。她一路上，沒有放開過你的手。
哈哈哈！老和尚，你閉關二十年，看人的眼光，倒是一點沒變。
無涯，有一件事，我必須告訴你。慧明……在龍淵閣的大會上，死了。
不對。那孩子七天前就該回山了。他臨下山前說，要去鏡湖，替老衲取一部經。
老衲一直在等他回來。可他，再也沒有回來過。
從來就沒有回到萬佛峰的人，怎麼會代表萬佛峰，去龍淵閣？
左手舉杯……佛門弟子，喝了三杯酒。老和尚，你那徒弟，可會喝酒？
那孩子，連茶都不肯喝濃的。
凌雲霄！聽說你輸給了夜無極？
好。下一次，你先贏他，再來跟我打。你可別在那之前，就被他打死了。
二十年前，你說要遊遍天下，看盡人心。看完了嗎？
看完了天下，卻還沒看完人心。
你這一生，算盡天下，卻總是算不到你自己。
所以，才需要你這個老朋友。
老衲有一句話，二十年前沒說，今天說給你聽：算計，救不了所有人。
……我知道。可不算計，一個人都救不了。
你醒了以後，第一句話，就是問劍譜。
黃昏。佛者出關的消息，比鐘聲傳得還快。
老和尚，你出關得正好。本尊正想看看，二十年的禪，擋不擋得住幽冥的掌！
阿彌陀佛。施主一身死氣，回頭是岸。
岸？本尊從幽冥爬回來，岸，就在本尊的腳下！
兩位少俠，退下吧。這一掌，老衲來接。
……老和尚……你等著，本尊，還會回來的！
阿彌陀佛。他的身子，已經不是人的身子了。
幽冥帝君，把他做成了一把刀。一把，殺不死的刀。
九霄來遲了！佛者，各位，可都安好？
殷兄，你每次都來得，剛剛好晚一步。
魏兄，你可曾想過，為什麼每一次出事，洛無塵都剛好在場？
大會上，他替燕飛霜說話；太虛峰上，他早就知道夜無極會去。今天，佛者又是他請出來的。
九霄什麼都沒說。九霄只是覺得，一個什麼都算得到的人，最可怕的，不是他算到了什麼……
而是他算到了，卻不告訴你。
夜深。太虛長老青松子傷重未癒，獨自在山門外調息。
佛者！你為什麼要殺青松道長！
……我親眼看見的。是佛者的掌，是大日佛印！
九霄也看見了。這……這叫九霄，如何向道門交代？
無涯！昨夜，你殺了青松子！
昨夜，老衲整夜，都在禪房，為凌少俠運功。
是真的。佛者一夜沒有離開過我。
作證？你們都是一夥的！洛無塵，從大會開始，你就在包庇每一個人！
燕飛霜的毒，你說不是她。青松子的死，你又說不是他。那到底是誰？是鬼嗎？
不是鬼。是一個，可以變成任何人的人。
洛先生，這種話，在三教之前，可要有憑有據。
……師兄死在佛門的掌下。這件事，貧道必須給道門一個交代。
佛者，請隨九霄回龍淵閣，接受三教共審。
不行！佛者剛剛才救了凌大俠——
阿彌陀佛。燕姑娘，老衲去。
佛門的封印，老衲帶著。是非曲直，總會有水落石出的一天。
等一下！昨夜我也在！我、我看見了兩個佛者！
一個在禪房的窗子裡，一個在山門外面！一模一樣！
錢不二，你的話，江湖上有誰會信？上個月，你還說你見過龍。
那、那次是我收了錢……可這次是真的啊！
（一個騙子說了一次真話，卻沒有人信……這才是最好的騙局。）
（有人戴著佛者的臉……他已經不只是在殺人。他在殺的，是所有人之間的信任。）
一掌渡劫，一掌殺人；同一張臉，兩顆心。
佛者下山，三教共審。龍淵閣上，誰才是審判的人？
en: The Peak of Ten Thousand Buddhas. Its gate has been shut for twenty years; in all that time no one has seen the Buddha on the peak.
Master Luo, will the Buddha really see us?
He will not see us. But he will not refuse a man who is dying.
Wuya! Twenty years. An old friend has come to see you — and brought someone you will surely save!
One palm carries three thousand worlds across their trials;
half a thought of Zen, and it is spring for ten thousand years.
Luo Wuchen. With that one shout you have broken twenty years of my meditation.
If your meditation breaks at a single shout, there is no need to sit any longer.
The death of the Netherworld has reached his heart. Three hours later and not even an immortal could have saved him.
Great Buddha, I beg you — save him!
Amitabha. That is why I came out: to save a life.
The Buddha’s light went into him, and inch by inch the death was driven out of Ling Yunxiao’s heart.
...My thanks to the Buddha for my life.
Do not thank me. If you must thank someone, thank this girl. She never let go of your hand the whole way.
I — I was only afraid he would fall!
Ha ha ha! Old monk — twenty years shut away, and your eye for people hasn’t changed a bit.
Wuya, there is something I must tell you. Huiming... died at the council in the Dragon Abyss Pavilion.
That cannot be. The boy should have been back seven days ago. Before he left he said he was going to the Mirror Lake, to fetch a sutra for me.
I have been waiting for him to come back. He never did.
Then the Huiming at the council...
How could a man who never came back to the Peak go to the Pavilion in the Peak’s name?
He lifted his cup with his left hand... a Buddhist disciple, and three cups of wine. Old monk — did your disciple drink?
The boy would not even drink strong tea.
Ling Yunxiao! I hear you lost to Ye Wuji?
Good. Next time you beat him first — then you fight me. Just don’t get yourself killed before then.
Twenty years ago you said you would travel the whole world and see every heart in it. Have you finished?
I have seen the world. I have not finished with men’s hearts.
All your life you have reckoned out the whole world, and never once reckoned out yourself.
Which is why I need an old friend like you.
There is something I did not say to you twenty years ago, and I will say it now: scheming cannot save everyone.
...I know. But without scheming, I could save no one at all.
When you woke up, the first thing you asked about was the manual.
...No. The first thing I asked about was you.
...Master Ling, you are getting better and better at saying things.
Dusk. The news that the Buddha had come out travelled faster than the bell.
Old monk, you came out just in time. I wanted to see whether twenty years of Zen can stand against the palm of the Netherworld!
Amitabha. You are wrapped in death, my friend. Turn back — the shore is behind you.
The shore? I crawled back out of the Netherworld — the shore is under my feet!
Enough talk! Get past me first!
Young masters, stand back. This palm is mine to meet.
...Old monk... you wait. I will be back!
Amitabha. His body is no longer a man’s body.
The Netherworld Emperor has made him into a blade. A blade that cannot be killed.
I am late! Great Buddha, everyone — are you all unhurt?
Brother Yin, every time you come — just exactly one step late.
Brother Wei, have you ever wondered why, every time something happens, Luo Wuchen happens to be there?
At the council he spoke for Yan Feishuang. At Void Peak he knew already that Ye Wuji would come. And today, it was he who brought the Buddha out.
What are you trying to say?
I say nothing. I only feel that, with a man who foresees everything, the frightening thing is not what he foresees...
it is what he foresees and does not tell you.
Late at night. Qingsong Zi, elder of the Void School, his wounds not yet healed, sat alone outside the gate to steady his breath.
Let me look at your wounds once more, Master.
Great Buddha! Why have you killed Master Qingsong!
...I saw it with my own eyes. It was the Buddha’s palm — the Seal of the Great Sun!
I saw it too. How... how am I to answer to the Taoists for this?
Wuya! Last night you killed Qingsong Zi!
Last night I was in my cell all night, working the light into Young Master Ling.
It is true. The Buddha never left me all night.
Wuchen will bear witness as well.
Witness? You are all in it together! Luo Wuchen, ever since the council you have been covering for every one of them!
The poison — not her, you say. Qingsong Zi’s death — not him, you say. Then who? A ghost?
Not a ghost. A man who can become anyone.
Master Luo, words like those, before the Three Teachings, need proof.
...My elder brother died under a Buddhist palm. I must give the Taoists an answer for it.
Great Buddha, I must ask you to come with me to the Pavilion, to be judged by the Three Teachings.
No! The Buddha just saved Master Ling —
Amitabha. Miss Yan — I will go.
I will bring the Buddhist seal with me. Right and wrong will come out in the end, as the water falls and the stones show.
The Buddha’s great heart — I am in awe.
Wait! I was there last night too! I — I saw two Buddhas!
One in the window of the meditation cell, one outside the gate! Exactly the same!
Qian Bu’er, who in the whole world believes a word you say? Last month you claimed you had seen a dragon.
That — that time I was paid to say it... but this time it’s true!
I do not listen to a liar.
(A liar tells the truth for once, and no one believes him... that is the best deception of all.)
(Someone is wearing the Buddha’s face... and it is no longer only men he is killing. He is killing the trust between all of us.)
One palm to save, one palm to kill; the same face, two hearts.
The Buddha comes down the mountain to be judged. But in the Pavilion — who is the judge?
